title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 灾害、热浪、市场保护、身体安全、文化再叙事与数字基础设施
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：systems under stress（承压的系统）。地震和热浪把城市、医院和住房推到极限；钢铁关税、油价和仓储地产让市场背后的产业基础浮出水面；身体安全、文化记忆和 AI 教育则提醒我们，真正重要的不是单个事件，而是系统如何回应人的脆弱。

items.title: 委内瑞拉宣布紧急状态：双重地震考验公共安全系统
items.summaryChinese: 委内瑞拉发生两次强震，官方宣布进入紧急状态，死亡人数上升，救援人员正集中前往受灾最严重地区。地震不仅摧毁建筑，也会立刻测试医院容量、通信系统、道路通行、救援调度和政府公信力。灾害发生时，真正被检验的是一整套公共安全基础设施。
items.correspondingEnglish: Venezuela declared a state of emergency after two powerful earthquakes, as rescue teams moved toward the hardest-hit areas. An earthquake does not only destroy buildings. It also tests hospitals, communications, transport, emergency planning and public trust. In a disaster, the whole infrastructure of public safety becomes visible.

englishExpressions.example: The government declared a state of emergency after the earthquakes.
Rescue teams moved toward the hardest-hit areas.
A disaster tests public safety infrastructure.

items.title: 欧洲热浪继续：医院、住房与工作场所同时承压
items.summaryChinese: 欧洲多地继续遭遇极端高温，英国气象部门将红色高温警报延长，欧洲多地热浪相关死亡人数上升。英格兰部分医院因机器和 IT 系统在高温下故障而宣布关键事件，MRI 扫描仪、冷却设备和病房工作量都受到影响。热浪正在把气候危机转化为基础设施危机。
items.correspondingEnglish: Extreme heat continued across Europe, with the UK Met Office extending a red heat warning and heat-related deaths rising. Some hospitals in England declared critical incidents as machines, IT systems and cooling units failed in the heat. The heatwave shows how climate risk can quickly become an infrastructure crisis.

englishExpressions.example: The Met Office extended a red heat warning.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 关键事件；重大应急事件
englishExpressions.example: Hospitals declared critical incidents during the heatwave.
Climate risk can become an infrastructure crisis.

items.title: 英国收紧钢铁进口配额：贸易保护与产业安全重新上桌
items.summaryChinese: 英国计划将免关税钢铁进口配额减半，以应对廉价中国钢铁过剩，并把超出配额部分的进口税提高。钢铁新闻看似传统工业议题，但它牵动就业、制造业能力、供应链安全和国家产业政策。市场不是自由漂浮的数字，它也由关税、配额和战略行业保护塑造。
items.correspondingEnglish: The UK plans to halve tariff-free steel imports in response to a glut of cheap Chinese metal, while raising duties on imports outside the new quota. Steel policy may look like an old industrial issue, but it is connected to jobs, manufacturing capacity, supply-chain security and industrial strategy.

englishExpressions.example: The government plans to reduce tariff-free imports.
Imports outside the quota will face higher duties.
Steel policy is part of industrial strategy.

items.studyNote:
Finance note
这不是投资建议。金融与市场栏目关注价格、贸易和产业政策如何影响就业、供应链与公共生活。

items.title: 油价降至冲突前低点：风险情绪正在重新定价
items.summaryChinese: 商业实时报道显示，油价跌至冲突开始前以来的最低水平。能源价格的回落并不只是市场技术走势，也反映投资者如何理解中东风险、航运安全、供应预期和未来通胀压力。读金融新闻时，重点不是判断买卖，而是理解价格如何表达风险和信心。
items.correspondingEnglish: Oil prices fell to their lowest level since before the conflict began. The move is not only a technical market change. It reflects how investors read geopolitical risk, shipping security, supply expectations and future inflation pressure. Prices often express fear and confidence before events are fully settled.

englishExpressions.example: Oil prices fell as geopolitical concerns eased.
Supply expectations can move energy markets.
Lower oil prices may reduce inflation pressure.

items.title: Fortescue 女性员工集体诉讼：偏远矿区里的身体安全
items.summaryChinese: 澳大利亚 Fortescue 女性员工发起集体诉讼，称偏远矿区存在性骚扰和不安全住宿环境。有女性称曾在飞进飞出式住宿房间里发现男性，也有人称遭到男性骚扰。矿业劳动常被描述为资源、工资和效率，但这类案件提醒我们：工作场所安全也包括住宿、夜间空间、性别权力和投诉机制。
items.correspondingEnglish: Female workers have brought a class action against Fortescue, alleging sexual harassment and unsafe conditions at remote mine sites. The case shows that workplace safety is not only about machinery and wages. It also includes housing, night-time space, gendered power and complaint systems.

englishExpressions.example: Workers filed a class action over conditions at remote mine sites.
The case includes allegations of sexual harassment.
Workplace safety includes protection from harassment.

items.title: 欧盟与塔利班接触引发阿富汗女性愤怒
items.summaryChinese: 欧盟与塔利班接触引发阿富汗女性和人权倡议者愤怒。争议的核心是：当安全、移民和外交利益被放在桌面上时，女性权利是否会被交换、延后或降级。性别政治有时不出现在“女性栏目”里，而隐藏在外交选择和安全话语之中。
items.correspondingEnglish: EU engagement with the Taliban has sparked anger among Afghan women and rights advocates. The central question is whether women’s rights can be traded away, delayed or downgraded when security, migration and diplomacy dominate the agenda. Gender politics often hides inside foreign policy language.

englishExpressions.example: Rights advocates criticized the diplomatic engagement.
Women’s rights should not be traded away.
Gender politics can hide inside foreign policy language.

sections.heading: 书籍、文化与艺术 / Books, Culture & Arts

items.title: Frida Kahlo 展览：当艺术家被品牌化，复杂性如何被保存？
items.summaryChinese: 伦敦大型展览重新审视 Frida Kahlo，但评论提出一个尖锐问题：当 Kahlo 的形象被做成礼品店里的“品牌 Frida”，真实的艺术家是否被遮蔽？她粗粝、政治化、复杂的生命经验，不应只被消费成抵抗和个性风格的图标。艺术展览的价值，在于把偶像重新还给复杂性。
items.correspondingEnglish: A major London exhibition revisits Frida Kahlo while asking whether the marketable brand of Frida has obscured the real artist. Her image has become a symbol of resistance and personal style, but the person and the work are more complex. A good exhibition can return complexity to an icon.

englishExpressions.example: A marketable brand can obscure a complex artist.
Kahlo’s image became a symbol of resistance.
The exhibition returns complexity to an icon.

items.title: 轮椅舞者进入《吉赛尔》：经典舞台的身体边界被重新打开
items.summaryChinese: 一位使用轮椅的表演者参与 Royal Ballet 相关舞蹈项目，在《Giselle》的训练和表演经验中重新接近童年对舞蹈的渴望。这类艺术新闻不只是励志故事，它改变我们对“舞者身体”的想象：经典舞台并不是固定的，它可以因不同身体进入而被重新定义。
items.correspondingEnglish: A wheelchair user joined a Royal Ballet-related dance project and explored what it means to move through Giselle. The story is not only inspirational. It changes the idea of the dancer’s body. A classical stage is not fixed; it can be redefined when different bodies enter it.

englishExpressions.example: A wheelchair dancer can change how audiences understand movement.
The classical stage can be opened to different bodies.
Inclusive dance can redefine movement.

items.title: 童军推出 AI 与数字徽章：技术素养成为生活技能
items.summaryChinese: 英国 Explorer Scouts 为14至18岁青少年推出 AI、内容创作和线上安全等新徽章。传统童军技能常让人想到野外生存、团队协作和动手能力；现在，数字身份、信息安全和 AI 工具也被纳入“生活技能”。这说明 AI 素养不再只是电脑课内容，而是青年理解社会、保护自己和参与公共生活的一部分。
items.correspondingEnglish: Explorer Scouts in the UK have launched new badges for teenagers covering AI, content creation and online safety. Scouting skills once suggested outdoor survival and teamwork. Now digital identity, information safety and AI tools are also treated as life skills. AI literacy is becoming part of how young people understand society and protect themselves.

englishExpressions.example: AI literacy is becoming part of youth education.
The badge teaches teenagers about online safety.
Digital literacy is now treated as a life skill.

items.title: SpaceSail 与 Starlink 竞争：卫星互联网成为数字主权基础设施
items.summaryChinese: 中国 SpaceSail 拥有数百颗低地球轨道卫星，并获得国家支持，正在被视为可能挑战 Starlink 的卫星互联网项目。它能否成为替代方案，取决于发射规模、国际合作、价格、监管和地缘政治信任。卫星互联网不是单纯商业产品，而是通信、灾害响应、国家安全和数字主权的基础设施。
items.correspondingEnglish: China’s SpaceSail has hundreds of low Earth orbit satellites and state backing, and is being watched as a possible rival to Starlink. Whether it can become an alternative depends on launch scale, partnerships, pricing, regulation and geopolitical trust. Satellite internet is infrastructure for communication, disaster response, national security and digital sovereignty.

englishExpressions.example: SpaceSail is building a low Earth orbit satellite network.
Satellite internet can connect remote regions.
Satellite networks are part of digital sovereignty.

englishParagraph.english: Today’s stories show what happens when systems are placed under stress. Earthquakes test public safety before politics can explain the damage. Heatwaves expose weak hospitals, housing and workplaces. Markets reveal how governments protect industries and how investors price risk. Gender stories remind us that safety is built through law, labor and space. Culture and technology then ask a deeper question: who gets to participate in the future, and under what conditions?
englishParagraph.chinese: 今天的新闻让我们看到，当系统承压时会发生什么。地震在政治语言解释损失之前，就先测试公共安全；热浪暴露医院、住房和工作场所的脆弱；市场显示政府如何保护产业、投资者如何为风险定价；性别新闻提醒我们，安全是通过法律、劳动和空间建造出来的。文化与科技则提出更深的问题：谁能够参与未来，又是在什么条件下参与？

keywords.meaning: 基础设施；支撑系统运行的物质与组织条件
keywords.example: A heatwave can expose weak infrastructure.
The government raised tariffs on steel imports.
Workplace safety includes protection from harassment.

keywords.meaning: 数字主权；对关键数字基础设施的掌控能力
keywords.example: Satellite internet is linked to digital sovereignty.

keywords.meaning: AI素养；理解并安全使用AI工具的能力
keywords.example: AI literacy is becoming a basic life skill.
Disasters can test public trust in institutions.

sentenceLab.sentence: Gender stories remind us that safety is built through law, labor and space.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: 这个句子用 remind us that 引出观点，核心是 safety is built。built through law, labor and space 表示安全不是抽象感受，而是由法律、劳动制度和空间安排共同建造出来的。

reflection.english: When systems are under stress, hidden structures become visible.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：当系统承压时，隐藏的结构就会显形。

rawText:
推送日期｜2026年6月25日

今天的小报关键词是：systems under stress（承压的系统）。地震、热浪、钢铁贸易、身体安全、艺术再叙事和数字基础设施共同提醒我们：系统如何回应人的脆弱，决定了新闻真正的意义。
